title: Live in Offenbach 1978
release: WDR Rockpalast; the Forecast: Tomorrow DVD (Columbia/Legacy, 2006); MIG 80090 (2016)

evidence.note: September 1978: the 29th by the upload, the 28th by a retailer.

drum_performances.name: Peter Erskine
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The quartet with Pastorius filmed whole in his first year, the band without a percussionist.

drums.description: His shuffle at 167: the ride swung, 2 and 4, the kick on 1, 3, its "and" and the "and" of 4; the snare on every "and" under the riff, the band's hits on the "and"s, the ride in quarters, the open hat on the beat. In the film from 1:32:16.

evidence.note: The bars from a machine tab; the tempo and the shuffle from the record and Erskine's own account.

drums.description: The hat closed on 1 and its "e" and open on the "and", 2 and 4; a build in six-bar steps, each adding to the kick and the hat; sixteenths on the hat. At 135, pushing to 145. In the film from 1:15:19.

evidence.note: The bars from a machine tab of this performance.
